info.title: tamp — small-core, plugin-driven build automation framework
info.description: Tamp global tool, dotnet-verb flavor. Install via `dotnet tool install -g dotnet-tamp`; invoke as `dotnet tamp <target>`. For the bare `tamp <target>` form, install the sibling `Tamp.Cli` package instead.

commands.name: init
commands.description: scaffold Build.cs into the current dir

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print every CommandPlan that would run; execute nothing.

options.name: --plan
options.description: Render the target dependency graph; execute nothing.

options.name: --list
options.description: List top-level targets (or all, if none are marked).

options.name: --all
options.description: Used with --list / --list-tree: show internal targets too.

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
Shortcuts for --verbosity quiet | --verbosity verbose
Tamp locates a build project under build/, _build/, or .tamp/build/ in the
current working tree (or an ancestor) and forwards the invocation to it.
Documentation: https://github.com/tamp-build/tamp
